title: SPA-announced demonstrations against RSF detention centres
reason: Announcement without an identified date or evidence that the planned gathering occurred.
notes: The article also reports a separate actual Jan12 Resistance Committees vigil, retained as E003. Do not count the planned SPA action as an executed event.

title: Delling bakery stoppage, price adjustment and committee meeting
reason: The report describes bakery owners changing prices, bakeries stopping baking and a trade/committee meeting, but no public protest gathering or >=50 assembled participants.
notes: The Jan21 article is opened. This action is retained as context for E006 and source evidence, but not as a separate mass-mobilization event. The work stoppage in El Obeid is separately pending evidence.

title: Police/army clash at a Wad Madani fuel pump
reason: The article describes a clash between police and army at a fuel pump, not a public protest gathering.
notes: Do not treat a security-force clash as demonstrator activity, state response to a different protest, or a protester-violence event.
